projects.title: Noise Pollution in Festivals & Events
projects.summary: Research into how festival and event noise affects health, everyday life and urban communities.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: A research-driven design project exploring how noise from festivals and events impacts health, daily life, and urban communities, aiming to create balanced solutions between cultural celebration and community well-being.

projects.title: Panchkalyanak Management System
projects.summary: Service design research into the systems behind a large-scale spiritual event at Namokar Tirth.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: A service design research project focused on understanding and improving the management system of Digambar Jain Panchkalyanak at Namokar Tirth. The project explores how large-scale spiritual events operate as temporary cities, highlighting challenges in accommodation, food systems, volunteer coordination, and information flow to design a more seamless and organized experience.

projects.title: Smart Kitchen Management System
projects.summary: A unified restaurant dashboard for inventory, staff, safety, recipes and point-of-sale management.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: A Smart Kitchen Management System designed to streamline restaurant operations by integrating inventory, staff, safety, recipe, and POS management into one unified platform. It enables real-time monitoring, data-driven decision-making, and predictive insights to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and ensure consistent service quality across outlets.

projects.title: Two Factor Authentication
projects.summary: A usability study of two-factor authentication in Indian banking apps, exploring security, accessibility and trust.

sections.body: A comprehensive usability study exploring how two-factor authentication impacts user experience, security perception, and accessibility in Indian banking apps, highlighting key challenges and opportunities to create a more seamless and trustworthy digital banking experience

projects.title: StreamBot - Movie Recommendation Chatbot
projects.summary: A conversational movie discovery experience that recommends content around mood, genre, language and viewing preferences.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: StreamBot is a conversational movie recommendation chatbot that helps users discover personalized content across OTT platforms based on their mood, genre preferences, language, and viewing interests. It simplifies content discovery, reduces decision fatigue, and provides quick, relevant recommendations through an interactive chat-based experience.
